_doc: Board settings for grid_router.py (RF board, p2c, D-156). Layers in stack order; 'dir' is the main direction (V/H) of a routing layer; route false = obstacle only. rf_clear: clearance of routed copper to fixed_nets copper per layer (M-70: DRC does not check it). F is restricted to the logic regions, to boxes around the listed parts, and to pad_breakout around the net's own SMD pads.
_doc_costs: Step costs per 0.1 mm grid step and turn costs (Prins 2026-10-24, option A): a 45-degree step costs more than a step against the main direction, and a 90-degree turn less than two 45-degree turns, so branches leave a straight track at right angles (T) and corners get the 45-degree chamfer.
_doc_seg_min: Minimum track segment between two bends or a bend and a via, mm (M-78). Connections whose search window is too large for the extra state, or that cannot be routed with it, fall back to the plain search and are reported.
_doc_h_weight: Weight on the A* heuristic for the search with minimum segment length: about 10 times faster; the path cost is at most h_weight times the optimum (M-78).

return_vias._doc: D-156, M-79: a signal via between F/In2 (reference L2) and In3/B (reference L5) gets a GND via within radius mm; the search keeps that room

_doc_no_narrow: Nets that keep the class width (coil supply: 0.254 mm over 115 mm of +12V_RLY would drop about 0.2 V at 0.4 A, M-79)

pairs._doc: detector and comparator inputs (victims) against bias, switching and coil lines (aggressors), M-81

_doc_fixed_nets: D-189: the relay NC pads (pad 12, not used) are joined to the common while the coil is off, so they are RF: rf_pad_clear on all layers, as pads 11 and 14
_doc_keepout_file: D-189: written by export_geom.py. The case GND seat faces B1 to B10 (diameter 10, RF-CASE-01 rev B) under the SO-239 and SMA GND screw holes: no track or via of a net other than GND within 5.5 mm of the hole centre; plus the support keep-outs S1 to S6 (R 4.5, rule areas SUP_KO) that only the support's own CHASSIS_Sn net may cross
_doc_pad_clear_skip: D-189: the relay NC pads keep rf_clear per layer (2.0 mm outer, 0.5 mm inner, D-12 and D-117) instead of rf_pad_clear on all layers, so the drive lines keep their inner channels through the relay field
